corrections.canonical_scope: M128 proves arithmetic and protocol behavior only for each accepted descriptor. It does not implement or cost a complete row-partition producer. Unsorted IDs, holey source_valid fields, and a repeated source split across two descriptors of the same row are not quarantined by the production RTL.
corrections.completion_scope: The untagged row_done pulse is delayed with the output and may overlap an update belonging to the next row under cross-row II1. Completion must be interpreted from an accepted update carrying update_last, or a successor must provide a tagged done payload.
corrections.ready_scope: M128 group_ready while group_valid=0 depends on descriptor semantic payload. The source must keep the payload stable and must not derive group_valid combinationally from group_ready.
corrections.bandwidth_scope: The reported 53 bits count descriptor payload only, not the complete interface, buffering, or producer traffic.

successor_requirements: Encode source count canonically and derive validity and selected-mask information internally.
Require strictly increasing source IDs inside a descriptor and across descriptors of the same row.
Make idle ready capacity-only and preserve no combinational valid/ready dependency.
Carry last with update and provide a tagged completion token.
Cost descriptor generation and traffic separately from the fold datapath.
